settings.heading: Root was born out of our desire to ease the journey for new moms.
settings.body_text: As fellow parents, we understand the challenges and struggles that come with parenthood. By sharing our experiences and creating Root, we hope to help new moms save time, energy, and alleviate some of the stressors that we encountered.

settings.heading: Mission
settings.mission_text: Our mission is to alleviate the physical and emotional burdens that come with being a new mom. We strive to provide nutritionally balanced products that increase energy levels and reduce stress for new moms, allowing them to better care for themselves and their babies.

settings.heading: We created Root because moms deserve more
settings.story_text:
When siblings Julia and Alex became new parents just three months apart (exciting!), their discussions quickly shifted from gripes about their mother (parents, amirite?) to the challenges of caring for a newborn.

As they navigated this new journey together, both babies suffered from allergies and colic, prompting Alex's wife—who happens to be a double-board-certified MD, btw—to join in on the conversation and share ideas for better baby care and more restful sleep. They tried new diets, consulted new doctors, and scoured new sections of grocery stores. Phew.

While these efforts helped the babies, the moms were still exhausted and struggling to keep up with the dietary demands of round-the-clock breastfeeding and pumping. They needed something that didn't exist: Clean, healthy, allergen-free, lactation-boosting nutrition that was quick and easy to consume. And so Root was born.

Breastfeeding takes a lot out of you (literally!). If you or your partner, friend, wife, sister, beloved cousin (whoever!) are struggling to maintain a sufficient breast milk supply, we're here for you.
